name: Mirror with Six Circular Flowers
dimensions: Diameter: 16.6 cm (6 9/16 in.); Overall: 1.5 cm (9/16 in.); Rim: 0.9 cm (3/8 in.)
summary: Around the mirror’s central knob, there are six floral designs set within circles, separated by candelabra-like dividers.
